description: Shared Renovate preset of DominikSienkiewicz; consumers extend github>DominikSienkiewicz/Platform. It covers GitHub Actions and Docker images only. Gradle, npm and the Platform pins come from the Platform catalog and frontend canon and are bumped by platform-bump (reusable platform-bump.yml).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the cooling-off period and the Monday window.

packageRules.description: Gradle and Gradle wrapper versions come from the Platform catalog (CLAUDE.md rule 1); platform-bump moves them.
Frontend versions are governed by versions.json; update them with platform-bump.
Platform's own reusable workflows are called by an exact vX.Y.Z that platform-bump moves; Renovate neither updates nor SHA-pins them.

customManagers.description: Testcontainers image tags in PlatformImages.java (datasource docker); a no-op in repositories without that file.
